title: 1 August 1966: Interview: David Frost At The Phonograph
content:
Paul McCartney took part in a radio show, David Frost At The Phonograph, in which the eponymous host interviewed a guest and played records.

The interview was pre-recorded ‘as live’ in Studio B15 in London’s Broadcasting House. It was first broadcast from 12-1.30pm on Saturday 6 August on the BBC Light Programme.
